original_test_intent: Validate every DIMM in the approved 1DPC population under a 12-hour memory workload at 40C and +5% rails, with no training, ECC/RAS, application, BMC or stability failures.
original_method: Power down/discharge under ESD; map DIMM serial/PN/capacity to socket/channel/slot and install approved 1DPC; capture training/SMBIOS/EDAC baseline; calibrate environment; boot and run pinned SST memory profile for 12 hours with allocation/coverage, temperatures, corrected/uncorrected ECC, RAS/MCE/SEL and heartbeat monitoring; abort on limits; restore nominal environment and reference DIMM population if required.
manual_activity: Operator installs 1DPC population, controls environment, supervises stress and restores hardware/conditions.
agent_execution_scope: Analyze supplied inventory, stress, telemetry and error evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly manual; remote stress alone cannot prove 1DPC physical identity or margin.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator runs the approved all-DIMM SST profile after physical/population/environment verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 1DPC, all DIMMs, 40C/+5% rails and 12 hours retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a DIMM-slot coverage ledger joined to workload allocation, environmental trace and per-channel ECC/RAS evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable DIMM topology, ESD controls, measurable coverage and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct total capacity cannot prove every intended slot was installed or stressed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong population can prevent POST; memory stress can expose thermal/ECC faults or OOM unrelated to media if profile is not bounded.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines exact 1DPC topology, coverage percentage, allowed corrected ECC, training retries and restoration requirement.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All sources consistently require manual 1DPC all-DIMM stress under environmental margin.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose is clear; execution is manual pending physical and environmental setup.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row8 Wistron-Margin-00007-V002: approve 1DPC DIMM serial/PN/capacity socket-channel-slot map and population rule, SST version/profile/coverage for 12 hours, 40C/+5% tolerances, ECC/RAS/MCE/training/thermal/OOM limits, abort and memory/environment restoration.

review_improvement: Links physical 1DPC population to actual per-slot stress and RAS evidence rather than relying on aggregate capacity or a tool token.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory population and workload coverage are separate: firmware may train fewer DIMMs, while a stress tool may allocate less than total memory. Slot-level identity and allocation/ECC evidence are both needed across the same margin interval.
